title: the WATCHME gate is CodeMother's
intention: CodeMother holds the WATCHME gate machine, cairn/devices/codemother/machines/watchme/gate.py WatchmeGate, answering verb machines/watchme/watch with body {ticket, holds, finding}: a red finding over a ticket at PROVED or WATCHME makes that ticket's own instance fail (Ticket.failed), so it reaches FIXME carrying the finding as its one watchme lack, tells the harbor, and asks design to queue it; a green finding changes nothing. Every standing WATCHME probe and watchme spec is repointed to it, and harbor_master's watch verb leaves.
why: Outline 3.3.4, 3.3.4.1 and 9.4.1.5 (Akien 2026-11-10): the gates are CodeMother's; harbor_master's bus face answers status queries and the crossing notice only, and its watch verb leaves; a ticket refused at a gate sends itself back to design, and with no handler it throws a trouble and waits. Measured 2026-11-10: harbor_master declares watch (cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master/device.py:60), 92 probe files post verb watch to harbor_master, 39 report-to-the-watch proofs assert that address, and 96 ticket state files name receiver 'harbor_master watch verb'.
traces_to: outline 3.3.4, 3.3.4.1, 9.4.1.5; RULE 1 (the gate reaches the ticket through the Ticket class, never through the harbor); Law 6 (the actor is the envelope's sender).
how: One new machine directory (charter committed b0fbf84f) holding gate.py; codemother's device declares it through declared_machines; a scripted repoint of the probe files, their proofs and the ticket records; harbor's handler, its verb and its proof leave.

clauses.claim: CodeMotherDevice().declared_verbs() contains 'machines/watchme/watch', and HarborMasterDevice().declared_verbs() contains no 'watch'

a watch {ticket, holds false, finding} from sender fixture_prober over a fixture ticket at [PROVED], with a spy participant that bounces every request, returns accepted true and acted fixme; the ticket's state cursor stands at FIXME with fixme [{n 1, kind watchme, missing <finding>}]; the history.json beside the probe's charter gains one entry to FIXME whose why says WATCHME finding; the spy saw a crossing post to harbor_master with direction back and one request with verb machines/design/queueme; and a trouble ticket-unqueued-<id>-at-design stands in the fixture roots

a watch with holds true writes nothing and posts nothing (acted none, ticket bytes unchanged, no history.json); a red finding over a ticket at [BUILDME] is accepted with acted none, a said naming BUILDME, and the ticket's bytes unchanged

each malformed watch is refused with accepted false and a reason naming its lack, the ticket's bytes unchanged and nothing raised: no sender (sender), no ticket (ticket), an id no plan resolves (ticket), holds not a bool (holds), holds false with an empty finding (finding), a watchme naming no probe (probe), a probe under no charter (charter)

over the live tree: every ticket at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme names a probe that exists imports to a PROBE whose verb is not 'watch' unless its to is 'codemother' and its verb is 'machines/watchme/watch'; no probe file under cairn/, bin/, skills/ or press_office/ posts to harbor_master with verb watch; and no ticket record in the commons names receiver 'harbor_master watch verb'

decisions.text: D1: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/watchme/gate.py. Constants HOLDER='codemother', VERB='watch', RECEIVER={'what': 'codemother watchme gate', 'in': 'cairn/devices/codemother/machines/watchme'}. class Voice(DiagnosticBase): __init__(bus, sender=HOLDER); request(**kw) returns bus.request(sender=self.sender, channel='personal', **kw); post(**kw) returns bus.post(sender=self.sender, channel='personal', **kw); when bus is None, reach() from cairn.tools.bus_client is dialed on first use. class WatchmeGate(DiagnosticBase): __init__(*, participant=None, roots=None) where roots is {repo, commons, instance} or None for the live world (repo = the cairn root, tickets = ticket_file._TICKETS); declared_verbs() returns {'watch': self.watch}. watch(envelope) keeps harbor_master._handle_watch's checks and wording in order (sender, ticket, holds bool, finding on red, find_ticket, read_ticket, watchme probe, probe walked up to the nearest intention+why.json under repo, refusing one under none with a reason naming 'charter'); holds true replies acted none; a cursor (transitions' cursor reader) not at PROVED or WATCHME replies acted none naming the step; otherwise Ticket.at(found, roots=roots).failed([{'kind': 'watchme', 'why': finding}], participant=..., history_path=<comp>/history.json, state_path=<comp>/state.json, actor=<sender>, why=f'a WATCHME finding: {finding}') and replies {accepted true, verb watch, device codemother, ticket, acted fixme, queued, trouble}. Every reply carries verb 'watch' and device 'codemother'; refusals are data (Law 7). Imports no device (RULE 1).

D2: CodeMotherDevice.declared_machines() in cairn/devices/codemother/shim.py returns {'watchme': WatchmeGate(participant=Voice(self._bus))}; codemother's charter held_machines gains 'watchme' through the artifact door.

D3: harbor_master's device.py loses the 'watch' entry in declared_verbs and _handle_watch; its proof proofs/test_watch_receives_a_finding.py and validations/test_watch_receives_a_finding.json leave (the validation through bin/cairn artifact remove); after the deletion this ticket's state gains a forwarding order from that proof path to the new proof.

D4: one scratch script repoints every live address: in each probe file where to="harbor_master" stands with verb="watch", to becomes "codemother" and verb becomes "machines/watchme/watch"; in each report-to-the-watch proof and the three other proofs asserting it (operator_inbox test_operator_inbox, proof_coverage test_call_time_binding, question test_question_links) the asserted to, verb and RECEIVER follow; the docstrings of watch_carry (cairn/tools/base/probe.py) and the harbor note in cairn/tools/bus_client/bus_client.py name the new receiver; each commons tickets/*.state.json whose watchme receiver is {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', ...} is rewritten with gate.RECEIVER through ticket_file.write_state(verb='cast').
writes_to: the probe files and proofs named by the census

decisions.text: D5: the proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/watchme/proofs/test_a_watchme_finding_fails_its_ticket.py, red-first, PROVES 386ea8131006 clauses 1 to 5, one tooth each, binding WatchmeGate at call time. Clauses 2 to 4 build a scratch world (the harbor proof's _world shape: commons/tickets with the live store charter copied in, comp/intention+why.json, comp/probes/p.py), point ticket_file._TICKETS at it, construct WatchmeGate(participant=<spy>, roots=<world>) and call watch(envelope). The spy bounces every request with body {is_bounce: true}. Clause 5 reads the live tree and the live commons beside the main tree.
